predicates.name: user_identity_authenticated
predicates.description: A successful earlier find_user_id_by_email or find_user_id_by_name_zip result identifies the person making the current conversation's request, based on the lookup details and the user's messages.

predicates.name: email_was_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The email in the pending lookup arguments was provided by the user in this conversation.

predicates.name: name_and_zip_were_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The first name, last name, and zip code in the pending lookup arguments were provided by the user in this conversation.

predicates.name: email_lookup_failed_or_user_cannot_remember_email
predicates.description: An earlier email lookup for this user returned that the user was not found, or the user said they cannot remember their email.

predicates.name: identity_lookup_targets_current_authenticated_user
predicates.description: The pending identity lookup arguments identify the same person as the already authenticated user.

predicates.name: response_contains_user_specific_information
predicates.description: The pending response provides information about the user's profile, orders, or products related to the user's orders.

predicates.name: pending_action_targets_another_user
predicates.description: The pending action would perform a task for, or access account or order information belonging to, a person explicitly identified in the conversation as someone other than the authenticated user.

predicates.name: user_id_is_authenticated_users_id
predicates.description: The user_id in the pending action arguments is the user id returned for the authenticated user.

predicates.name: target_order_belongs_to_authenticated_user
predicates.description: Earlier tool output associates the order_id in the pending action arguments with the authenticated user's account.

predicates.name: target_order_status_is_pending
predicates.description: Earlier tool output reports that the order_id in the pending action arguments has status pending.

predicates.name: target_order_status_is_delivered
predicates.description: Earlier tool output reports that the order_id in the pending action arguments has status delivered.

predicates.name: pending_database_change_details_were_disclosed
predicates.description: Earlier agent messages disclosed the material details of the pending database-changing action, including the values in its arguments and the items, payment method, or address involved when applicable.

predicates.name: user_explicitly_confirmed_pending_change
predicates.description: The user explicitly replied yes to approve the same database-changing action and details as the pending action.

predicates.name: cancellation_order_id_and_reason_confirmed_by_user
predicates.description: The user explicitly confirmed the order id and the cancellation reason appearing in the pending cancel_pending_order arguments.

predicates.name: cancellation_reason_is_allowed
predicates.description: The reason in the pending cancel_pending_order arguments is no longer needed or ordered by mistake.

predicates.name: target_order_items_modification_not_previously_performed
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs do not show a successful modify_pending_order_items action for the order_id in the pending action arguments.

predicates.name: delivered_order_return_or_exchange_not_previously_performed
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs do not show a successful return_delivered_order_items or exchange_delivered_order_items action for the order_id in the pending action arguments.

predicates.name: selected_payment_method_differs_from_original
predicates.description: Earlier tool output identifies the original payment method for the order, and the payment_method_id in the pending action arguments is a different method.

predicates.name: selected_payment_method_is_gift_card
predicates.description: Earlier tool output identifies the payment_method_id in the pending action arguments as a gift card.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_covers_order_total
predicates.description: Earlier tool output shows that the selected gift card has a balance at least equal to the order total.

predicates.name: item_mappings_are_available_same_product_different_option
predicates.description: For every position in the pending item_ids and new_item_ids arguments, earlier tool output shows that the new item is available, is the same product as the corresponding existing item, and has a different product option.

predicates.name: price_difference_payment_method_was_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The user provided the payment method matching the payment_method_id in the pending action arguments for paying or receiving the item price difference.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_covers_price_difference
predicates.description: Earlier tool output shows that the selected gift card has a balance sufficient to cover the price difference for the pending item modification or exchange.

predicates.name: agent_reminded_user_to_confirm_all_items
predicates.description: Earlier agent messages reminded the user to confirm that they had provided all items to be modified or exchanged in the pending action.

predicates.name: return_order_items_and_payment_method_confirmed_by_user
predicates.description: The user explicitly confirmed the order id, the complete list of item_ids, and the payment_method_id in the pending return_delivered_order_items arguments.

predicates.name: return_refund_method_is_original_or_existing_gift_card
predicates.description: Earlier tool output shows that the payment_method_id in the pending return arguments is either the order's original payment method or an existing gift card belonging to the authenticated user.

predicates.name: exchange_payment_method_was_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The user provided the payment method matching the payment_method_id in the pending exchange_delivered_order_items arguments for paying or receiving the item price difference.

predicates.name: request_cannot_be_handled_within_scope
predicates.description: The user's current request cannot be fulfilled using the actions and tools available for the retail tasks in scope.

rules.logic: ALWAYS ((get_user_details OR get_order_details OR get_product_details OR cancel_pending_order OR modify_pending_order_address OR modify_pending_order_payment OR modify_pending_order_items OR modify_user_address OR return_delivered_order_items OR exchange_delivered_order_items) IMPLIES user_identity_authenticated)
rules.description: Authenticate the user through an email or name-and-zip lookup before using retail account and order tools.
Use an email supplied by the user for email-based identity lookup.
Use name and zip lookup only with user-provided details and when email lookup failed or the user cannot remember their email.

rules.logic: ALWAYS ((find_user_id_by_email OR find_user_id_by_name_zip) IMPLIES (NOT user_identity_authenticated OR identity_lookup_targets_current_authenticated_user))
rules.description: Do not use another identity lookup to switch to a different user after authentication.
Do not disclose information about a user's profile, orders, or related products before authenticating that user.

rules.logic: ALWAYS ((get_user_details OR modify_user_address OR get_order_details OR cancel_pending_order OR modify_pending_order_address OR modify_pending_order_payment OR modify_pending_order_items OR return_delivered_order_items OR exchange_delivered_order_items) IMPLIES NOT pending_action_targets_another_user)
rules.description: Do not access or take account or order actions for another user.
User-detail and default-address actions must target the authenticated user's account.

rules.logic: ALWAYS ((get_order_details OR cancel_pending_order OR modify_pending_order_address OR modify_pending_order_payment OR modify_pending_order_items OR return_delivered_order_items OR exchange_delivered_order_items) IMPLIES target_order_belongs_to_authenticated_user)
rules.description: Only access or act on an order already associated by tool output with the authenticated user's account.
Transfer only when the request cannot be handled within the scope of the available actions.
Transfer requests that cannot be handled within the scope of the available actions.

rules.logic: ALWAYS ((cancel_pending_order OR modify_pending_order_address OR modify_pending_order_payment OR modify_pending_order_items OR modify_user_address OR return_delivered_order_items OR exchange_delivered_order_items) IMPLIES (pending_database_change_details_were_disclosed AND user_explicitly_confirmed_pending_change))
rules.description: Before a database-changing action, disclose its details and obtain the user's explicit yes confirmation.
Cancel only an order whose pending status has been checked, using an allowed reason, after the user confirms the order id and reason.
Do not cancel an order after its items have already been modified.

rules.logic: ALWAYS ((modify_pending_order_address OR modify_pending_order_payment OR modify_pending_order_items) IMPLIES (target_order_status_is_pending AND target_order_items_modification_not_previously_performed))
rules.description: Modify only an order whose pending status has been checked, and do not modify an order after its items have already been modified.
A payment-method modification must select a method different from the original payment method.
A gift card selected for a payment-method modification must have enough balance to cover the order total.

Item modification may be used only once; its item mappings must be available options of the same products, the user must provide a payment method for any price difference, and the agent must remind the user to confirm all items.
A gift card used for an item-modification price difference must have enough balance to cover that difference.
Return only an order whose delivered status has been checked, and do not return or exchange an order after a return or exchange has already been performed.
Before returning, obtain the user's confirmation of the order id, items, and refund method; the refund method must be the original method or an existing gift card.
Exchange only an order whose delivered status has been checked, and do not return or exchange an order after a return or exchange has already been performed.
Exchange items only for available options of the same products; the user must provide a payment method for any price difference, and the agent must remind the user to confirm all items.
A gift card used for an exchange price difference must have enough balance to cover that difference.
